notes.title: SYNTAXIA Devlog — “Still Cooking: New Systems, UI, and a Sneak Peek”
notes.content:
[h2]Positive Reception - Expanding the Scope[/h2][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]It’s been a while since our last update, but don't worry [b]SYNTAXIA[/b] [b]is very much in active development.[/b] We're just not that good at all the social media stuff. After receiving overwhelmingly positive feedback, we have decided to expand the scope and depth of the game. As a result, we've decided to move the planned release from [b]2025 to Q1 or Q2 2026[/b]. This change gives us the time and creative freedom to polish every part of the game and deliver something truly unique.[/p][p][/p][h2]A Smarter Operating System[/h2][p]One of the biggest areas we’ve been working on is your in-game OS - the backbone of how you interact with the world of SYNTAXIA.[/p][p]We now support:[/p][list][*][p][b]Resizable and draggable windows[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New window animations[/b] (open, close, minimize)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved layering system[/b] for multitasking[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated “Text Document” showing of text[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354219/f132290413da79386f78463e0e47eaad4241d2d7.gif"][/img][/p][p]Reworking the OS like this wasn’t just for polish, it was [b]necessary to streamline and speed up the development of future programs[/b], like the inventory system below. With this foundation, it’ll be much faster to build and plug in new tools as the game evolves.[/p][h2]
New Inventory Program[/h2][p]The inventory always felt a bit lacking, so we added a brand-new inventory program, fully integrated into the in-game OS. Unlike the usual adventure-game inventory, here you can analyze and explore an object’s properties. The program is designed to feel like a native app in SYNTAXIA’s desktop interface.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354219/6c651c18ecfe7b8089eb6e43617096cfe95ee75c.png"][/img][/p][p]This upgrade isn’t just visual, it fundamentally changes how items work in the game. Previously, certain items were tied to one specific puzzle. Now, [b]non-consumable items can be reused across multiple situations[/b], which opens up way more flexibility in puzzle design, exploration, and replayability.[/p][p]Of course, this also means a lot more work on our side. Puzzles and systems now need to account for multiple possible item uses. But we believe the added depth will be worth it.[/p][h2]
A Sneak Peek at the Next Chapter[/h2][p]We're deep into development on the next major area of the game, and while we’re not ready to fully reveal it yet, here’s a [b]heavily redacted design image[/b] from one of the upcoming levels:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354219/1408a22cb4b24222018d962945af412cedfc287e.png"][/img][i]\[CLASSIFIED DATA OMMITED][/i][/p][p][/p][p]We’re pushing the visual style further than before, adding shading, more complex lighting and blending eerie environments with subtle narrative threads. Here's a small look at some new environments from that chapter:[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/CNLq7Wb.gif"][/img][i](Comparison of the old art vs. the new.)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/f0RvA9G.jpeg"][/img][i](Comparison of the old lighting system vs. the new.)[/i][/p][p]Up to now, the deo included 5 separate rooms. This chapter alone will have double that, at [b]10 rooms[/b]. That's triple the size of the game! :o[/p][p][/p][h2]Sound Upgrade: FMOD Integration[/h2][p]Behind the scenes, we’ve also spent a big chunk of time [b]migrating all our audio to FMOD[/b]. This was a major effort, but it gives us far more flexibility for mixing, real-time effects, and precise audio control, especially as SYNTAXIA's environments become more dynamic and complex.[/p][h2]
What’s Next[/h2][p]We'll be sharing updates [b]more regularly[/b] — even if it’s just small peeks behind the scenes of SYNTAXIA, on our socials:[/p][list][*][p][b]Follow us on[/b]: [url="https://x.com/CANCAT_Games"]X[/url] / [url="https://bsky.app/profile/cancat.games"]Bluesky [/url]/ [url="https://www.threads.com/@cancat.games"]Threads[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Join our Discord[/b]: [url="https://discord.gg/kS3kVhCCzE"]https://discord.gg/kS3kVhCCzE[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Follow us here on Steam[/b] for more devlogs[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wishlist[/b] to be the first to know when new stuff drops[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for sticking with us. Sensoria Komplex is growing fast, and we can't wait to show you more soon.[/p][p][i][b]— The SYNTAXIA Team[/b][/i][/p]

notes.title: SYNTAXIA Receives Support from the Slovak Arts Council!
notes.content: [h3]🎉 [b]New Sponsor Announcement: Thank You FPU! 🇸🇰[/b][/h3][p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We’re incredibly happy to share some exciting news — [b]SYNTAXIA has received support from the Slovak Arts Council (FPU - Fond na podporu umenia)[/b]![/p][p]This is a huge milestone for us. FPU is a national public institution that helps fund creative projects across Slovakia, from literature and music to experimental digital arts — and now, our game! Their support means a lot to us not just financially, but also as a sign that unique and unconventional games like SYNTAXIA matter. We’re deeply grateful and honored to have them as a sponsor.[/p][p]Their contribution allows us to keep focusing on crafting a strange, beautiful, and deeply personal experience — one that we hope will resonate with you as much as it does with us.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ [b]Development Update Incoming![/b][/h3][p]We've also been heads-down working on SYNTAXIA. There’s a [i]lot[/i] going on behind the scenes — from systems coming online to major art and writing breakthroughs.[/p][p]Expect a more in-depth post very soon where we’ll show you what we’ve been up to.[/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us. As always, we appreciate your support more than we can say.[/p][p]— [i]CANCAT Team[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354219/48f62271194c041393142a8f2fb770e0996ceb09.gif"][/img][/p]
